summary_en: Nippon Yusen announced correction to its tender offer for NS United Kaiun (code 9110), disclosing that it has entered into application agreements with nine shareholders holding 1,235,220 shares (5.24% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) as of June 30, 2026, including its wholly-owned subsidiary Utsumi Tug & Barge.
title_en: Corrective Notice: Notification of Correction to "Notification of Planned Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of NS United Kaiun Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 9110)"
translation_en_brief: Nippon Yusen Kabushiki Kaisha (NYK) issued a corrective notice dated November 6, 2026, revising its announcement from July 31, 2026, regarding the tender offer for NS United Kaiun Co., Ltd. (code 9110). The key correction involves disclosure that NYK has entered into application agreements with nine shareholders totaling 1,235,220 shares, representing 5.24% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of June 30, 2026. These nine shareholders include Shin Jian Shipping (504,840 shares; 2.14%), Mizuho Bank (400,000 shares; 1.70%), Imabari Shipbuilding (75,000 shares; 0.32%), Norinchukin Bank (75,000 shares; 0.32%), and others. Notably, Utsumi Tug & Barge, NYK's wholly-owned subsidiary, entered into an application agreement for its full holding of 45,800 shares (0.19%), which represents a change from the original plan. Initially, NYK intended only to request Utsumi Tug & Barge to tender its shares without a formal agreement, relying on the subsidiary relationship. However, to increase certainty of the tender offer's success, NYK concluded an application agreement with Utsumi Tug & Barge on November 6, 2026. The target company's board of directors approved the tender offer contract and recommended that shareholders tender their shares in the offer. A special committee previously established by the target company will review whether its opinion from July 31, 2026, remains unchanged at the commencement of the tender offer.
